title: The Final Descent
description: Crescius Caerellius believes the East Empire Company covered up his great-grandfather Gratian's death in Raven Rock Mine. Explore the mine, find Gratian's remains and journal, escape Bloodskal Barrow, and return the evidence to Crescius.

base_facts: I am an old ex-miner living in Raven Rock.
I believe the East Empire Company is hiding something in the depths of Raven Rock Mine.
My great-grandfather Gratian Caerellius died in the mine almost 200 years ago.
The Company claimed Gratian died in a rockfall, but I know better.
I found Gratian's old key and an unsent letter about a strange discovery in the mine.

SPEAK_TO_CRESCIUS: Someone has come to listen to my story about the mine.
ACCEPT_QUEST: An adventurer has agreed to explore the mine and find Gratian's remains.
FIND_JOURNAL: They found Gratian's journal deep in the mine.
COMPLETE_QUEST: The truth about Gratian's death has finally been uncovered.
Player returns to Crescius with the evidence and the quest is completed.

The tunnel leads to a dead end with yet another angry spider, so proceed down the woodworks and find the tunnel to the northwest, past several crates and barrels with the East Empire Company logo, as well as some.

Locate the narrow passageway next to the pressure plate and follow it as it twists and turns, then uncover the second huge secret of the mine: Gratian Caerellius [ edit ] "I'm afraid this tomb will become my resting.

base_facts: I am Crescius's wife and I worry about him exploring the dangerous mine.
Crescius is obsessed with finding his great-grandfather's remains down in the mine.

SPEAK_TO_CRESCIUS: Someone is asking about our argument over the mine.

beats.comment: Player encounters Crescius arguing with Aphia in Raven Rock Mine and speaks to him.
Player agrees to help Crescius explore the mine and find Gratian's remains.
Player finds Gratian's remains and journal deep in Bloodskal Barrow.
Player escapes Bloodskal Barrow after solving the puzzle and is ready to return.
Player returns to Crescius with the evidence and the quest is completed.
